versions.title: What's New in qs-v1.0.2
versions.subtitle: Cursor Quick Paste, tri-state desktop modes, obsidian glass blur controls, and tuned physics.

features.title: Cursor Quick Paste (SUPER + V)
features.description: Open an obsidian-glass Quick Paste popup directly at your cursor showing your 12 most recent copied texts and links with instant 1-click auto-paste.

features.title: Desktop Modes & Blur Engine
features.description: Switch cleanly between full obsidian glass, direct-scanout Game Mode, and distraction-free Class Mode. Added dual-tone borders, wobble physics, and top bar support.

features.title: Spotlight Omnibar & Calculators
features.description: Embedded command center featuring live daily exchange rates across 26 currencies, multi-category unit conversion across 11 systems, emoji search, and inline math.

features.title: Obsidian Glass & Spring Tuning
features.description: Unified translucent glass tokens across Dock, Dynamic Island, and Lockscreen with lockstep slide-and-wobble window curves and edge-clamped hover tooltips.

versions.title: What's New in qs-v1.0.1
versions.subtitle: Pure Quickshell migration milestones, new desktop modules, and native Polkit authentication.

features.title: Island Weather System
features.description: Embedded Page 1 of notch carousel. Provides live temperature, 7-day outlook, wind, humidity, and hourly metrics with zero external API key requirements.

features.title: Native Package Updater
features.description: Rebuilt from GTK4 into native Quickshell. Scans official Pacman, AUR (paru/yay), and Flatpak in parallel with real-time terminal streaming and package delta inspection.

features.title: Dynamic Island Polkit
features.description: All privileged actions (pkexec, updates, disk managers) invoke Quickshell Island's native PolkitAgent. The notch expands smoothly for password input with physical shake-on-fail.

features.title: Single-Event Escape Logic
features.description: Eliminated ambiguous shortcut collisions across nested views. Pressing Esc at any time instantly collapses expanded search inputs, launchers, and full-screen modals.
